units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:16">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 16</cite>.—Pl. <he>יוֹהֲרִין</he>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:4">Targ. Esth. I, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 4:7">Targ. Lam. IV, 7</cite> (Var. <cite ref="G00089"><he>זְהוֹרִין</he></cite>); <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:2">Targ. Cant. VII, 2</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>גּוּהֲרִין</he>.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 17b:9">Ber. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>מחזי כי׳</he> it looks like an assumption (to appear more observant than others).
<cite ref="Berakhot 17b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>חייש לי׳</he> cares for the appearance of assumption (and therefore forbids); <cite ref="Pesachim 55a">Pes. 55ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 26b:10">Succ. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>לית ביה משום י׳</he> there is no appearance of presumption to be apprehended in doing so.
